svg.title: Rebind logo usage sheet, media kit v1
svg.text: REBIND · LOGO USAGE · MEDIA KIT V1
CREATOR KIT · FILES ONLY · DRAFT FOR REVIEW
A · THE MARK: SIX-CELL BLOCK R (REPO FILE MARK-BLACK.SVG / MARK-WHITE.SVG)
LIGHT · #111111 INK ON #FFFFFF
DARK · #FFFFFF INK ON #000000
CLEAR SPACE
Keep one cell width (the side of one
square) clear on every side. The dashed
box shows the minimum clear zone.
MINIMUM SIZE
Mark: 24 px tall on screen; 6 mm in print.
Below 24 px use the repo favicon.svg /
favicon.ico cut, never a scaled-down mark.
Lockup: 32 px mark height; 6 mm in print.
COLOUR
One flat ink only: #111111 or #000000 on
light, #ffffff on dark. No accent colour,
gradient, shadow, outline or container.
SIZE LADDER
24PX
32PX
48PX
96PX
B · WIREFRAME LINE MARK (REPO FILE LOGO-REBIND-LINE.SVG) · FOR OUTLINE / WIREFRAME LAYOUTS
Use the line mark inside wireframe frames and title cards.
Same six cells, square caps, miter joins, no fill. Do not mix
the line mark and the solid mark in one frame.
C · PROVISIONAL LOCKUP: MARK + REBIND (INCONSOLATA BOLD, UPPERCASE) · USE THIS IN THE KIT
PROVISIONAL · USE IN THE KIT
Dean's call (Nov 13): use this lockup in
the kit for name + mark placements. Keep
the PROVISIONAL label and filenames until
an official wordmark is final. Clear space
one mark cell; min 32 px mark height on
screen, 6 mm print. Mark A alone is fine
where space is tight. No symbol-text-*.svg.
D · DON'T (EACH TILE IS A MISUSE; THE LABEL SAYS WHY)
DON'T: NO FILL / CONTAINER
DON'T: NO GRADIENT
DON'T: NO SHADOW
DON'T: NO RECOLOUR
DON'T: NO STRETCH
SYMBOL-TEXT-DARK.SVG
SYMBOL-TEXT-LIGHT.SVG
DON'T: NO SYMBOL-TEXT-*.SVG
Repo source: E:\Marketing Repo\Rebind\rebind-logo\ and \brand-vectors\. Geometry copied unchanged.
